newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania cen.bank raises one-week rate to 51 pct.
newsitem.headline: Romania cen.bank raises one-week rate to 51 pct.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said on Thursday it had raised by two percentage point to 51 percent the minimum permitted rate for its refinancing funds.
The BNR kept the amount of one-week funds available at Thursday's auction at 1.35 trillion lei.

Traders said the recent upward move showed the central bank had tightened its monetary policy to try to prop the leu currency, whose retail rates weakened to 4,900 to the dollar from about 3,500 in mid-October.
One-week rates sank again to 34 percent after Wednesday's rise to 41 percent, as the money market again turned cash-heavy on Thursday.
